title: These are not "stickers"
text: These are not "stickers". I like the table runner and mantle scarf a lot. They're actually cuter in person than pictured. But I feel the term "stickers" to describe 113 out of the 115 pieces is misleading. These are vinyl window clings. They will not stick to most walls, as shown in the fourth picture. They're thin, dollar store window vinyl clings.
